subject: english
question:
Directions: Each item in this section consists of sentences with an underlined word followed by four words or group of words. Select the option that is opposite in meaning to the underlined word and mark your response on the answer sheet accordingly.

The Government __ruthlessly__ decided to force its citizens to pay taxes even during famine.
solution:
The correct answer is "**Leniently**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us understand the implication of the highlighted word:
 
• **R****uthlessly:** without pity or compassion for others; strict.(दूसरों के प्रति दया या करुणा के बिना; कठोर)
 
 
• Example: *They fell prey to money lenders who **ruthlessly **exploited them.*
 
 
 
• Let us understand the implication of the correct word:
 
• Leniently: something of mild and tolerant disposition or effect; not strict.(सौम्य और सहनशील स्वभाव या प्रभाव वाली कोई चीज़; सख्त नहीं)
 
 
• Example:* Because of her, she was likely to be treated **leniently**.*
 
 
 
• It is apparent from the above explanation that **"leniently**" is an** appropriate antonym** for "**ruthlessly"**.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is: ***leniently***

***​***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's understand the meaning of the remaining options:

 
 

 Word
 Meaning
 Example

 He was behaving indifferently towards her.
